authors: A. K. Covington, T. H. Lilley, R. A. Robinson
title: Excess Free Energies of Aqueous Mixtures of Some Alkali Metal Halide Salt Pairs
experimental_method: Isopiestic vapour-pressure method at 25 +/- 0.02 C: silver dishes on aluminium blocks in rocked desiccators, four duplicate determinations on the mixture with the pure component salts in the other four dishes, 1-4 days equilibration.
uncertainties_stated: None for the molalities; standard deviation of beta'/m-based phi deviation estimated 0.0010 (delta of phi), i.e. 0.6 cal/kg at 2 m and 2.4 cal/kg at 4 m in the excess free energy.
quality_remarks: Sodium bromide was prepared in-house by neutralising HBr with Na2CO3; other salts twice recrystallised. Temperature scale not stated. The osmotic coefficients in Tables II/III are interpolated from Robinson and Stokes tables for the reference salt. The NaBr-KBr block pair and all bromide mixtures are outside the six-ion set; kept because the table mixes in-scope (NaCl, KCl) and out-of-scope salts.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (NaCl-NaBr) and Table III (KCl-NaBr): derived (osmotic coefficients, deviation function, beta'/m, calculated) from the Table I data; m and yB duplicate Table I
Table IV (beta'/m), Table V (b01, b02), Table VI (excess free energies): fitted/derived model quantities

row_counts.Table I: printed 84 data rows (14 blocks x 6), written 84 data rows plus 14 label rows

extraction_notes: Text layer matched the image in every cell (checked all 84 data rows on 1.6x crops).
